spans.s:
(औ) दहौ r. 1st cl. (दहति)
To burn or reduce to ashes.
(इ) दहि r. 10th cl. (दंहयति)
1 To shine.
2 To burn.

m. (-हः)
1 Burning, combustion.
2 Morbid heat.
3 Actual or potential cautery.
E.
दह to burn, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्)
Scorching, burning.
E.
दह to burn, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Burning, combustion.
m. (-नः)
1 Fire, or the deity

AGNI.
2

A bad man, one of evil dispositions.
3 The marking nut plant.
4 Lead wort, (Plumbago zeylanica, &c.)
E.
दह to burn, affix ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
1 Burning, reducing to ashes.
2 Cauterising.
E.
दह to burn, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
Smoke.
E.
दहन fire, and केतन a banner or sign.

f. (-या)
A name of SVĀHĀ, the wife of AGNI.
E.
दहन fire, and प्रिया the beloved.

m. (-लः)
Fire.
E.
दहन, and बहुल much.

m. (-तिः)
Water.
E.
दहन, and अराति foe.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be or what may be burnt, combustible.
E.
दह to burn, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-लः)
The Sun-gem, a crystal lens.
E.
दहन fire, and उपल a stone; fire-stone.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Thin, small, fine.
m. (-रः)
1 A rat, a mouse.
2 A young animal.
3 A younger brother.
4 A child, an infant.
E.
दह to burn, affix अर.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Burnt, being burnt.
E.
दह to burn, pass. v., शानच् aff.

m. (ह्रः)
1 A name of AGNI or fire.
2 The conflagration of a forest.
E.
दह to burn, रक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Burning, inflammatory.
2 Cauterising, caustic.
m. (-कः)
A plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.)
E.
दह to burn, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-रः)
Inflammatory fever.
E.
दाह, and ज्वर fever.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Burning, heated, on fire.
E.
दाह, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-रः)
A place where dead bodies are burnt.
E.
दाह, and सृ to go or be, affix अप्; also with असुन् affix दाहसरस, n. (रः)

n. (-णं)
The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum).
E.
दाह heat, and हरण removing; this root being woven into screens, and kept wet, for the purpose of excluding or tempering the hot winds.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
To be burnt, inflammable.
E.
दह to burn, ण्यत् aff.
